surface_mechanism_description: A thin interfacial SiN_x layer was spontaneously formed at the HfO2/Si interface during film growth, which prevented substrate Si diffusion into the HfO2 film.
evidence: A thin interfacial SiN_x layer was spontaneously formed at the HfO2/Si interface during film growth. This interfacial SiN_x layer prevented substrate Si diffusion into the HfO2 film.
